```plato

    // The regularized UPPER incomplete gamma function Q(a, x) = 1 - P(a, x),
    // the survival function of the unit-scale gamma distribution. Continued
    // fraction above the split x = a + 1 (so the far tail keeps RELATIVE
    // accuracy), complement of the series below it (so near-zero tails are
    // accurate only absolutely, as in INumerical Recipes). Precondition:
    // a > 0, x >= 0.
    RegularizedGammaQ(a: Number, x: Number): Number
    {
        var prefactor = (a * x.NaturalLog - x - LogGamma(a)).Exp;
        return x <= 0.0
            ? 1.0
            : x < a + 1.0
                ? 1.0 - prefactor * LowerGammaSeriesSum(a, x, 0, 1.0 / a)
                : prefactor / GammaContinuedFraction(a, x, 0);
    }
}
```
